SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26005006
DOCKET NO. F00584624
PLAINTIFF – U.S. BANK NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY, BUT SOLELY AS TRUSTEE FOR THE RMAC TRUST, SERIES 2016-CTT
DEFENDANTS- NICOLE L. THOMAS; ET. ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 5th DAY OF January 2027
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of BLOOMFIELD, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
LOT 1 BLOCK 129
APPROXIMATE DIMENSIONS: .066 AC
NEAREST CROSS STREET: WILLOW STREET
UPSET PRICE: $586,700.00. *NOTE, THIS UPSET PRICE IS SUBJECT TO INCREASE AS OF THE DATE OF THE SALE AND YOU WILL NEED TO CONTACT THE SHERIFF OR PLAINTIFF'S COUNSEL FOR THE UPSET AS IT EXISTS ON THE DATE OF THE SALE.
OCCUPANCY: SAID PROPERTY IS OCCUPIED
*TAXES- AT TIME OF INQUIRY- TAXES PAID THROUGH 4TH QUARTER 2026;
*WATER- AT THE TIME OF INQUIRY-DELINQUENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,741.89 + INTEREST AND ANY ADDITIONAL CHARGES THAT MAY BECOME DUE THROUGH PAYOFF;
*SEWER-AT THE TIME OF INQUIRY-DELINQUENT IN THE AMOUNT OF $29.10 + INTEREST AND ANY ADDITIONAL CHARGES THAY MAY BECOME DUE THROUGH PAYOFF
(XX) SUBJECT TO: IF PROPERTY IS LOCATED IN A HOMEOWNER'S ASSOCIATION, THEN IT IS SOLD SUBJECT TO ANY ASSESSMENTS AND OTHER FEES WHICH MAY BE RESPONSIBILITY OF NEW OWNER UNDER NJ SUPREME COURT CASE OF HIGHLAND LAKES COUNTRY CLUB & COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION V. FRANZINO, 186 N.J. 99(2006)
(XX) SUBJECT TO: IF PROPERTY IS LOCATED IN A CONDOMINIUM OR HOMEOWNER'S ASSOCIATION, THEN IT MAY BE SOLD SUBJECT TO A ROLLING 6-MONTH LIMITED PRIORITY LIEN OF THE ASSOCIATION;
(XX) SUBJEC TO: *IF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS PART OF AN AGE RESTRICTED COMMUNITY, YOU MUST BE 55 AND OLDER AND INTEND TO RESIDE IN THE PROPERTY OR YOU MAY BE PRECLUDED MEMBERSIP IN THE COMMUNITY.
*ALSO SUBJECT TO SUBSEQUENT TAXES, WATER AND SEWER PLUS INTEREST THROUGH DATE OF PAYOFF
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
41 PROSPECT ST BLOOMFIELD, NJ 07003
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $513,914.85 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: November 18, 2026
ROMANO GARUBO & ARGENTIERI
52 NEWTON AVENUE
P.O. BOX 456
WOODBURY, NJ 08096
856-384-1515
